description: Shows a subheading, heading, and a list of "Bento" cards.  A great way to showcase some screenshots or graphics.

agentGuidance.useWhen: Showcases screenshots or graphics as a grid of picture-led cards with an eyebrow, title and description.
agentGuidance.avoidWhen: Short icon-led points (use FeatureGrid), or images shown one at a time (use carousel).

alternatives.when: icon, title and a sentence per item
